### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. All data for this comparison were collected at the Harbor Street Patients.

Table 5. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 96 | 500 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Side effects | 97 | 500 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Side effects | 110 | 500 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
